answer: Commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. Each candidate locks 1.00 unit in an escrow vault 8 epochs before entry and posts a secret hash. At each epoch's dawn the beacon publishes a seed; candidates reveal within 24 hours and a beacon-weighted lottery admits 2 percent. Unopened reveals forfeit the deposit. Auditors group reveals by funding origin; deposits clustering into a ridge of the commitment distribution are voided as a batch. An attacker funding N=100 sybils locks 100 units, expects 2 admissions, and burns 98 deposits.
